description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain known for its by-the-slice model with any toppings included, making it a quick and filling stop for hungry cyclists on Marine Drive in North Vancouver. The chain offers both classic and premium 'Feast' pizza varieties, with options for gluten-free cauliflower crust and dedicated veggie pizzas. Indoor seating is available, making it a practical rest stop regardless of weather.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 52m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags confirm this is an active Freshslice Pizza fast-food location with takeaway=yes and indoor_seating=yes. The website is the corporate homepage and does not provide location-specific details (phone, address, bike parking, washrooms), so most amenity fields default to null. The menu and nutritional info subpages confirm vegetarian pizza options (Veggie classic) and a gluten-free cauliflower crust, supporting a true value for Vegetarian/vegan/GF.
